profile.headline: Software Engineer | Web Developer | Game Developer
profile.summary:
Experienced IT Software professional, I have over 10 years of experience managing multi-disciplinary functions including Warehouse Management and Customer Care.I am a focused problem solver, constantly trying to streamline processes and generate efficiency.

Keen to employ novel methodologies to produce innovative solutions, I like to keep myself abreast of latest industry and market trends.I am also fond of working on JDM cars and designing my own software to use in said cars.I can be reached at kaylebrown3825@gmail.com

Specialties: Software Development, Programming, C++, C#, Unity, React, Angular, SQL, Python, Data Collection, Reasoning Skills, Analytical Skills, Conceptual Thinking, Critical Thinking, Detail Oriented, Communication Skills, Analytical Aptitude, Interpersonal Skills, Team Effort

positions.title: Information Technology Business Analyst
positions.description:
As Information Technology Business Analyst at Retro Fitness, I was responsible for writing reliable codes, implementing software architectural improvements, user-facing features or fixing defects and optimizing the code for maximum performance.

Key Achievements :-
- Improved financial model for software development start up, gathering information about target company and associated senior management; interacted with group of 7 technical consultants, evaluating target company's technology including IPs
- Evaluated and analyzed competing technologies to meet business needs; obtained approval for recommended technology from leaders, led deployment of technology across 5 business units impacting 2000 employees
